senses.gloss: f. pl. (פִּיפְיָרוּת, רִית—f. sing.) (√פר, cmp. b. h. פרפר = בקע to split; cmp. פַּרְפֶּרֶת, a. פְּרִיפְרִיוֹת, פִּרְפְּרָאוֹת) split pieces of wood, laths, slabs used for espaliers, also as frames for decorative hangings.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:15:3">Y. Sot. IX, end, 24ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:9">Tosef. Sot. XV, 9</cite> <he>אבל עושה הוא אפיפיי׳ וכ׳</he> but one may make lath frames and hang thereon whatever decorations he may desire. [Bab.
<cite ref="Sotah 49b:7">ib. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>פִּפְיָרִית</he>; Rashi <he>פְּרִיפְרִית</he> sing.] <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 6:3">Kil. VI, 3</cite> <he>על מקצת א׳</he> on a portion of the espaliers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 7:3">Ib. VII, 3</cite> <he>מותר א׳</he> the balance of the espaliers (on which no vine is trained).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:3">Kel. XVII, 3</cite> <he>אפי׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>פי׳</he>; Mish. <he>אפו׳</he>) frames for hangings to which reeds were fastened from the bottom upward (crosswise) for support.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 6</cite> (a. freq. in comment.) <cite ref="Q00783"><he>פִּיפְיָארוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:6">Ib.</cite> <he>פִּיפְיָארוּת שאינה וכ׳</he> a frame (baldachin) which cannot be taken up by its handles and carried through the door (outside).—Ch. <cite ref="Q00780"><he>פֵּיפוּרָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00785"><he>פִּיפְיוֹרָא</he></cite>. V. also <cite ref="Q00344"><he>פּוּרְיָא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A02817"><he>אַפִּרְיוֹן</he></cite>. [<cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite> softened into <cite ref="J00000"><he>י</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="H01512"><he>חצוצרה</he></cite>.]
